title: Advanced International Commercial Arbitration Masterclass
targetAudience: Senior Legal Counsel, Arbitrators, Litigation Partners
overview: An intensive executive program focusing on evidentiary proceedings, procedural tactics, cross-examination, and award drafting under ICC & UNCITRAL rules.
learningOutcomes: Master procedural order drafting and document production requests (IBA Rules)
Analyze grounds for setting aside awards in MENA jurisdictions

modules.title: Module 1: Constitution of the Tribunal & Jurisdictional Objections
modules.description: Handling Kompetenz-Kompetenz disputes and emergency arbitrator applications.

modules.title: Module 2: Evidence, Hearings, & Redfern Schedules
modules.description: Managing complex document production and virtual hearing protocols.

modules.title: Module 3: Award Drafting & Post-Award Strategy
modules.description: Ensuring enforceability and resisting annulment applications.

title: Legal Technology & AI for Modern Practitioners
targetAudience: Judges, Corporate Legal Directors, Academic Researchers
overview: Bridge the gap between legal practice and artificial intelligence. Learn how LLMs, predictive analytics, and automated compliance tools transform legal workflows responsibly.
learningOutcomes: Understand the mechanics of Large Language Models in legal drafting
Evaluate algorithmic bias and confidentiality concerns in legal tech
Design AI-augmented research and discovery workflows

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations of Legal Tech & AI Ethics
modules.description: Core concepts, prompt engineering, and ethical boundaries.

modules.title: Module 2: Practical Applications in Legal Drafting & Research
modules.description: Hands-on exercises with contract analysis and legal search tools.
